optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Water Treatment Plant Upgrades

professionalSummary.text: Senior project manager with four years of experience leading water treatment plant upgrade projects within a rolling capital programme, consistently delivering projects on time, within budget, and in compliance with regulatory and operational requirements.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a water utility's capital programme for four years, running three treatment plant upgrade projects under the utility's project framework with their project plans and outage schedules agreed with plant operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed three plant upgrade projects, each with a detailed project plan and outage schedule coordinated with plant operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Project manager on a water utility's capital programme for four years, running three treatment plant upgrade projects under the utility's project framework with their project plans and outage schedules agreed with plant operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Directed works contractor on site, issuing 41 site instructions, 9 variations, and 6 defect notices, achieving final accounts within approved budgets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Managed the works contractor on site under the works contract on all three projects; the contract records hold the forty-one site instructions, the nine variations and the six defect notices I issued, with the contractor's responses and the final accounts settled within the approved budgets.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly project board reports, filing decisions in the capital programme repository.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly project board report for each project, filed with the board's decisions in the capital programme repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored outage requests, documenting approvals by plant operations and delineating responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the outage requests for each project's works; the approvals were the plant operations manager's, recorded on each request together with which checks were mine and which were plant operations'.

experienceHighlights.text: Compiled closure reports with project boundary statements and commissioning evidence signed by the commissioning engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each project with the project boundary statement and the commissioning evidence signed by the commissioning engineer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a comprehensive work sample including a project plan, outage schedule, contract records extract (instructions, variations, defect notices), board report, and closure report, all referenced in the capital programme repository.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one project plan with its outage schedule, the contract records extract with instructions, variations and defect notices for one project, one board report and one closure report, with the capital programme repository references as a verification trail.
